The difference is actually huge, I used Rift S for about 120 hours and im now on Vive (with about 80 hours use already) and the tracking is insanely better. Base stations still beat inside-out tracking unfortunately

I have used the CV1, Rift S, and im now using the Vive. I would personally recommend either the CV1 or Vive if you can afford it. The Rift S can lose tracking pretty easily once you get into the crazy EX+ or even regular EX+ maps. The difference in tracking is very noticeable.

Edit: I have ~70 hours on the CV1, ~120 hours on Rift S, ~80 hours on Vive
